# Continuation Pass Three — Tiferes Execution Plan

The Awtsmoos joins breadth with rigor so the movie river flows as one;
Awtsmoos.com keeps each studio distinct while shared semantic truth gets done.

## Exact sequence
1. Fresh-read `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentNormalizer.js`.
2. Fresh-read semantic kind definitions and canonical validator.
3. Whole-file rewrite only the normalizer to preserve resolved dimension and use it consistently for entity adaptation and spatial defaults.
4. Discover existing shared-movie test convention.
5. Add a new focused regression test covering omitted/hybrid, 2D, and 3D scene dimensions with characters, particles, shapes, world, and light expectations.
6. Syntax-check implementation and test.
7. Run the focused regression test.
8. Run existing shared movie tests relevant to compiler/schema/bridge.
9. Read deterministic core evaluator and bridge paths; fix only proven defects using fresh reads and whole-file rewrites.
10. Inspect the 180-second showcase source and assert duration, scene count, 2D/3D coverage, people, charts, tutorial overlays, text/keyframes, particles, cameras, and transitions.
11. Run shared/core roundtrip and deterministic seek checks.
12. Trace Animator, Nesher Studio, Video Editor, and Mitzvah Studio adapters; verify each consumes or exports the canonical language while keeping its distinct UI/personality.
13. Browser-test the showcase and integrated studio surfaces at desktop and mobile viewport sizes, checking console errors and touch controls.
14. If the repository's canonical export pipeline is healthy, render the full 180-second media artifact and probe exact duration plus audio/video streams.
15. Re-read every file written by this pass, audit tabs/module size, compare planned versus actual, and record unresolved limitations honestly.

## Files this pass may own now
- `apps/shared/movie/ai/MovieIntentNormalizer.js` — whole-file rewrite after fresh read.
- One new focused shared-movie regression test — exact path chosen only after discovering current test convention.
- New continuation/verification notes in this mission folder.

## Files explicitly not yet owned
All currently modified Animator, Mitzvah Studio, shared bridge/core, and showcase source files remain read-only until a failing test proves a change is required and the latest contents are re-read immediately before any rewrite.

## Completion gate
A claim of “tested and verified” requires executable evidence: tests, browser checks, and—if supported by the existing export system—a real media file whose probe confirms the requested three-minute duration. A data document alone is not sufficient.
